s004: These terms set the conditions for using ShareRun (the "Service"), provided by 하상기 (the "Operator"). By using the Service you agree to these terms and to the Privacy Policy. The Privacy Policy governs how personal information is collected and used; these terms govern your use of the Service.
s006: ShareRun is an app for recording walks and runs, joining challenges and tournaments, and earning and sharing virtual currency based on your activity. The Operator provides record verification, rankings, rewards, donation information and notifications. Some features may be in preparation or unavailable in certain versions. The current release may not accept cash payments inside the app.
s008: You sign up with a method the Operator has opened: Google, Kakao or Naver. Anyone under 14 years of age cannot sign up.
s009: You can link additional sign-in methods to one account. Once linked, any of the methods opens the same account.
s010: Another sign-in method is not linked to an empty account that has no nickname. Before linking, the Operator shows only the nickname and SHARE balance of the target account and asks for your confirmation.
s011: You can unlink sign-in methods except the last one. Unlinking the last method is not allowed because you could no longer get back into the account.
s012: Identity verification and the currency ledger of an account are based on the records on the Operator's servers. Values that exist only on your phone are not the reference.
s014: SHARE, DIA and VALUE are virtual currencies used only within the Service. They have no cash value and cannot be transferred, sold or inherited between users.
s015: The ledger on the Operator's servers is the only reference for balances and changes. The numbers shown in the app display that ledger.
s016: If misuse, an error or a violation of these terms is confirmed, the Operator may withhold the currency concerned or take back currency already granted.
s017: When you delete your account, the remaining currency expires. It is not exchanged for cash or refunded.
s018: If paid purchases (such as Google Play) are reopened, the payment provider's policy and the refund rules announced at that time apply as well. In versions that do not accept cash payments, no payment cancellation or cash refund is provided.
s020: Rewards and rankings are limited to records you walked or ran yourself. Bicycles, scooters, vehicles, using someone else's records, location spoofing, automation and abuse through multiple accounts are prohibited.
s021: The Operator verifies records using distance, time, route, steps, movement, device integrity and similar signals. Records that do not meet the criteria are not recognized.
s022: If a fraudulent record is confirmed, no reward is granted for it, and the SHARE, DIA and VALUE already granted, as well as ranking and prize eligibility, may be forfeited or cancelled.
s023: Repeated or serious misuse may lead to your account being suspended or deleted.
s024: If you believe a record was wrongly rejected, you can ask for an explanation through the in-app appeal screen or the email address below.
